title: Home practical guide and safety card: evaporating salt water
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Dissolving, separating and plants (Do All Solids Dissolve? and Allotment)
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 34 (Home practical guide and safety card: evaporating salt water (portal worksheet; no heating at home))
intro: Lesson 34: Getting salt back: evaporation. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To get salt back from salt water by evaporation
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Stir two spoons of salt into half a cup of warm tap water until it dissolves
Pour a thin layer onto the saucer
Leave it on a warm windowsill (no heating at home)
Look every day for three days
Use the magnifying glass to see the crystals

questions.q: Water turning into a gas is...
Big question: how do people get salt out of seawater?
questions.a: Shallow pools; the Sun evaporates the water and salt crystals are left.
